name: task-multiplayer-conformance
description: Multiplayer conformance suites: 5-way editor convergence + 20-peer presence churn. Run from the repo dev shell (direnv or `devenv shell`) via `./run.sh` (builds server/CLI/wasm first) or `pnpm test` against prebuilt artifacts.
playwrightPinNote: @playwright/test must match the playwright-driver of the nixpkgs-dx input pinned in devenv.yaml, which supplies PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH in the dev shell — a mismatched pin looks for a browser build that isn't in the store and every test fails at launch. Same pin as features/editor/tests. Check with `nix eval --raw github:NixOS/nixpkgs/<devenv.yaml nixpkgs-dx rev>#playwright-driver.version` (see apps/tests/playwright/README.md).
